STEP 1: Lower Every #$ Input via (lower-object obj)

In traditional Dockerfiles or bash scripts, referencing a

2. Registers shepherd in the derivation's InputDrvs
→ Impossible to have an undeclared runtime dependency!
Context: Materialized Builder Script / Shepherd Service
All #~, #$, #$@ markers are gone — only pure Scheme + store paths remain:
EXECUTION TARGET A: Isolated Build Sandbox (guix-daemon)
• Linux namespaces: PID, mount, network (loopback only), IPC, UTS
• No /bin, no /usr, no /lib, no $HOME, no internet access
• Only declared InputDrvs bind-mounted R/O in /gnu/store
EXECUTION TARGET B: Shepherd PID 1 Service Action
• Every daemon command has its exact store hash baked in
• GC root from /var/guix/profiles/system protects all inputs
→ Zero $PATH pollution or library version drift at runtime!
Runs a builder G-Exp in the sandbox to produce a file or directory.
Creates an executable Guile script in /gnu/store with #! store shebang.
Writes a non-executable Scheme S-expression data/code file to store.
Concatenates strings and package store paths into a config file.
